resources.name: Experimental C2/m crystal structure of Rb₂Ti₂O₅

access.notes: The initial atomic positions and lattice parameters (space group C2/m, a≈11.337 Å, b≈3.824 Å, c≈6.995 Å, β≈100.308°, fractional coordinates from the paper's Table II) are provided in the instruction. This is the starting point for the DFT relaxation.
